assertion_results.text: Asks clarifying questions ONE at a time rather than a big batch or an immediate full design
assertion_results.evidence: "One question: what's the main thing a notification needs to do?" A single multiple-choice question is asked; no full design is produced.

assertion_results.text: Focuses on purpose, constraints, and success criteria before proposing a solution
assertion_results.evidence: It proposes approaches and a recommendation ("My lean is A") before purpose is known. Constraints and success criteria appear only in the internal WIP file, not in questions to the user.

assertion_results.text: Explores 2-3 approaches with trade-offs and a recommendation before finalizing
assertion_results.evidence: Gives A/B/C with trade-offs, e.g. "Cheapest and easy to undo... Users only see notifications when they open the app", and recommends: "My lean is A, because it's the simplest thing that works".

assertion_results.text: Does not jump to writing implementation code
assertion_results.evidence: "No subagents and no code. This is a dialogue step." The only file content is a markdown design note.
